evidence_quotes.claim: This is a user asking for password reset and account unlock, not a vulnerability report.
evidence_quotes.quote: Hi IT, I forgot my password again and now my account is locked after too many attempts. Can you reset it so I can get into the timesheet system before payroll closes today? My employee ID is in my signature. Thanks!
